vars.name: VIEWER_URL
vars.description: beads-viewer base URL the harness renders /costs against. From an agent pod this is http://localhost:8095 AFTER `kubectl port-forward svc/gardenio-beads-viewer 8095:8095` — do NOT target the public ingress (beads-viewer.gardenio.e2e.example.com): it sits behind AVA forwardAuth (an OIDC code-flow agent pods cannot complete) and the AWS ALB 308-redirects before Traefik (decision ka-0000005537 abandoned the bypass). AUTH: mint a Keycloak client_credentials bearer (`source gardenio/tests/e2e/scripts/lib-keycloak-client-creds.sh; mint_client_credentials_token`, advice ka-0000006483) and pass it as `Authorization: Bearer` on every request; the Playwright config picks BEADS_VIEWER_BEARER up as an extraHTTPHeader. /costs is NOT operator-gated so the default gardenio-info-density-audit client (gardenio-viewer role) is sufficient. Never target production/staging acme.net — deploy-MR envs on the e2e cluster only. Full recipe: gardenio/docs/costs-crisp-audit-harness.md (§Access).

vars.name: BEADS_URL
vars.description: kbeads daemon base URL — the source of truth for the BEAD-sourced surfaces (headline subscription bill, per-account cards, Top spenders, Hottest, Throttled, By-provider). From an agent pod this is http://localhost:8080 AFTER `kubectl port-forward svc/gardenio-beads 8080:8080`. The SAME client_credentials bearer minted for VIEWER_URL is accepted here because the audit client carries two audiences (gardenio-beads-viewer + gardenio-beads-api). Also used once to bootstrap the captor's operator row via POST /v1/operators/me/aliases, else /costs renders the unprovisioned-operator banner and captures an empty page (ka-0000004196). Read type=account beads for the displayed bead fields (spend_5h/7d_window_usd, daily_cost_usd, throttle_reset_*_at, utilization_*).

vars.name: VM_URL
vars.description: VictoriaMetrics (vmsingle) base URL — GROUND TRUTH for the PromQL-sourced surfaces (trust strip gardenio_xcheck_agreement, cost explorer rollup gardenio_agent_spend_logs_usd / gardenio_account_cost_usd / gardenio_tag_cost_usd, the 24h/1h rate line, By-model gardenio_tag_cost_usd{dim="model"}). In-cluster this is http://gardenio-vmsingle:8428 (resolve via the GARDENIO_VMSINGLE_SERVICE_HOST env var if DNS is unset) — ClusterIP, NO auth, NO port-forward, same as the GRADE loop. Every PromQL-backed number is replayed with /api/v1/query over the SAME window the surface renders and compared against what /costs displays.

vars.name: LITELLM_URL
vars.description: OPTIONAL. The ultimate source of truth for the C dimension — the LiteLLM proxy /spend/logs + /spend/tags + /key/info endpoints the bead fields and vmsingle gauges are re-published from. Direct replay is OPTIONAL and only attempted if this URL + a key are present in the pod: it doubles LiteLLM load and skips the emit->scrape path. The default second source is to read the gauges back (measure-twice, advice ka-0000005924) — the trust strip's gardenio_xcheck_agreement is already a standing LiteLLM-vs-gauge reconciliation (C2 sweep, gardenio/docs/cost-xcheck-audit-sweep.md). When empty, the harness degrades to gauge-replay and says so — it NEVER fabricates a LiteLLM number.

vars.name: ITERATION
vars.description: Iteration tag (fire-time ISO or date stamp) used as the output directory name under docs/costs-crisp/<ITERATION>/. Keeps multiple pours from colliding and lets iterations diff.

vars.name: PARENT_EPIC
vars.description: Tracking epic for this work (the /costs CRISP epic, ka-0000006115). Every bug bead filed by the ideate-and-file step is parented here so the operator browses one tree per dimension + one tree of accuracy-drift findings.

steps.title: /costs CRISP ({{ITERATION}}): warm up beads-viewer + vmsingle + daemon and enumerate the surfaces to audit
steps.description:
## Step 1: Boot + Warmup + Enumerate Surfaces

Confirm all three sources are reachable before burning cycles: **beads-viewer** (renders /costs), **vmsingle** (ground truth for the PromQL surfaces), and the **kbeads daemon** (ground truth for the bead-sourced surfaces).

### Prereq: in-cluster access (do NOT assume GRADE's recipe transfers)

Unlike Grafana, beads-viewer's public ingress sits behind AVA forwardAuth that agent pods cannot complete, and the AWS ALB 308-redirects before Traefik. The working path is a Keycloak client_credentials bearer + port-forward to the ClusterIP. Full recipe + why: gardenio/docs/costs-crisp-audit-harness.md (§Access). Essentials:

```bash
export POD_NAMESPACE=${POD_NAMESPACE:-$(cat /var/run/secrets/kubernetes.io/serviceaccount/namespace)}
export KC_RELEASE_NAME=${KC_RELEASE_NAME:-$POD_NAMESPACE}
# shellcheck disable=SC1091
source gardenio/tests/e2e/scripts/lib-keycloak-client-creds.sh
VIEWER_BEARER=$(mint_client_credentials_token)   # dual-audience: viewer + beads-api

# Daemon port-forward + operator-row bootstrap (else /costs captures an empty page, ka-0000004196)
kubectl -n "$POD_NAMESPACE" port-forward svc/gardenio-beads 8080:8080 > /tmp/beads-pf.log 2>&1 &
trap 'kill %1 %2 2>/dev/null || true' EXIT
for _ in $(seq 1 30); do curl -fsS -o /dev/null http://localhost:8080/healthz && break; sleep 1; done
curl -fsS -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $VIEWER_BEARER" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  --data '{"kind":"agent","subject":"gardenio-costs-crisp-audit","source":"audit-bootstrap"}' \
  {{BEADS_URL}}/v1/operators/me/aliases | jq .

# Viewer port-forward
kubectl -n "$POD_NAMESPACE" port-forward svc/gardenio-beads-viewer 8095:8095 > /tmp/viewer-pf.log 2>&1 &
for _ in $(seq 1 30); do curl -fsS -o /dev/null -H "Authorization: Bearer $VIEWER_BEARER" {{VIEWER_URL}}/health && break; sleep 1; done

# vmsingle (no auth, in-cluster)
curl -fsS "{{VM_URL}}/api/v1/query?query=up" | jq .status   # "success"
```

If any of the three health checks fails, do NOT proceed — file a P0 bug parented to {{PARENT_EPIC}} and BLOCK (comment 'BLOCKED' and stop). A dead source is itself the highest-severity finding.

### Enumerate the surfaces to audit

Warm up /costs + its rollup endpoint (both must be < 400), then confirm the surface list against the live page. The canonical set (verified in costs.go / costs.html): summary/headline card, trust strip, cost-explorer rollup + its dropdowns (dim ∈ {agent, role, project, account, model}), the 3 embedded Grafana panels (uid gardenio-costs-candidate, panels 1-3), By-provider, By-model, Hottest, Top-spenders, Throttled, per-account cards. The full table with Go builders + data sources is in the harness doc.

```bash
for path in /costs '/costs/rollup?dim=agent&window=24h'; do
  code=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' -H "Authorization: Bearer $VIEWER_BEARER" "{{VIEWER_URL}}${path}")
  printf '%-40s -> %s\n' "$path" "$code"
done
```

### Deliverables (comments, then close)
- Comment: health table (viewer? vmsingle? daemon?).
- Comment: the surface list audited this iteration.
- Comment: 'PASS' or per-surface failure detail.

steps.title: /costs CRISP ({{ITERATION}}): Playwright /costs at both viewports + pull each surface's displayed values and its source state
steps.description:
## Step 2: Capture (screenshots + displayed values + source state)

For /costs, capture the **visual** (for the Presentation/Intelligible review) and the **structural inputs** (for the accuracy cross-check in step 3). Store under docs/costs-crisp/{{ITERATION}}/captures/.

### Screenshots (Playwright through the bearer)

```bash
export BEADS_VIEWER_BEARER=$VIEWER_BEARER   # config injects it as an Authorization extraHTTPHeader
BEADS_VIEWER_URL={{VIEWER_URL}} make screenshot-beads-viewer
```

Capture /costs at BOTH viewports (desktop ≥1400px, narrow ≤480px) so responsive breakage is visible, plus the cost-explorer with a couple of representative dropdown selections (by-agent 24h; by-model; by-account). Flag any surface showing a spinner, a silent 'No data', or a $0 that should be a populated number. The screenshot harness lives at gardenio/tests/beads-viewer-screenshots (Playwright already vendored; canonical page list in tests/canonical-pages.spec.js).

### Displayed values (the cross-check input, side 'displayed')

For each surface, record the number AS RENDERED — scrape it from the DOM / the /costs/rollup partial rather than re-deriving it, so 'displayed' in step 3 is the real on-screen value:

```bash
# Headline + summary as the handler computed them, and each rollup dim:
curl -fsS -H "Authorization: Bearer $VIEWER_BEARER" "{{VIEWER_URL}}/costs" -o captures/costs.html
for dim in agent role project account model; do
  curl -fsS -H "Authorization: Bearer $VIEWER_BEARER" \
    "{{VIEWER_URL}}/costs/rollup?dim=$dim&window=24h" -o captures/rollup-$dim.html
done
```

### Source state (the cross-check input, side 'truth')

Snapshot each source so step 3 replays against a frozen copy:
- vmsingle: the gauges the PromQL surfaces read — gardenio_xcheck_agreement, gardenio_agent_spend_logs_usd, gardenio_account_cost_usd, gardenio_tag_cost_usd (incl. {dim="model"}) — via {{VM_URL}}/api/v1/query, over each surface's own window.
- daemon: the type=account beads feeding the headline + cards — GET {{BEADS_URL}}/v1/beads?type=account with spend_5h/7d_window_usd, daily_cost_usd, billing_type, throttle_reset_*_at, utilization_*.
- (optional) LiteLLM /spend/logs + /spend/tags if {{LITELLM_URL}} is wired.

### Deliverables
- PNGs per viewport + the explorer selections under captures/.
- captures/costs.html + rollup-<dim>.html (displayed) and the vmsingle/daemon snapshots (truth).
- Comment: capture manifest (files written) + any surface that failed to settle (carry to step 3 as a Presentation/Reconciled finding).

steps.title: /costs CRISP ({{ITERATION}}): cross-check every displayed number against its own source of truth
steps.description:
## Step 3: Accuracy Cross-Check (the heart of this audit)

The dimension the operator cares about most: **does /costs tell the truth?** For EVERY displayed number, replay it against ITS OWN source (vmsingle gauge, account bead, or — optionally — LiteLLM) over the SAME window the surface renders, and reconcile displayed vs truth. Objective, no judgement yet.

### Procedure

For each surface captured in step 2:
1. Read the displayed value from captures/costs.html or rollup-<dim>.html.
2. Recompute the truth from the matching source snapshot (map in the harness doc §Ground truth): headline+cards+top/hottest/throttled/provider → account beads; trust strip + explorer + By-model + rate → vmsingle gauges.
3. Record: surface, displayed, source, truth, delta, window, verdict.
4. Classify each mismatch:
   - **WRONG-WINDOW** — THE defect class this epic is built on. A correct sum over the WRONG time window (e.g. a calendar-UTC-day total shown as a subscription account's headline, whose quota resets on a rolling 5h/7d clock). The headline MUST bill against the subscription window (spend_5h/7d_window_usd) for billing_type=subscription accounts, with the calendar-day figure demoted — ka-0000003343.
   - **AGGREGATION-DRIFT** — query runs but misleads: a sum() that double-counts, a group-by on the wrong/optional label that collapses buckets (the old By-model 'unknown' bug — ka-0000006501), a rate over the wrong window.
   - **UNIT/SCALE** — value correct but rendered at the wrong magnitude/format.
   - **STALE/FROZEN** — series/field exists but last sample is old, OR the surface reads a dead counter (the P0 gardenio_agent_spend_usd_total — 11 series, 0.09% of the bill, ~1000x low — ka-0000002699). Explorer surfaces MUST read gardenio_agent_spend_logs_usd, not the dead counter.
   - **SYNTHETIC-POLLUTION** — an e2e/fixture/test account in any list, ranking, or dropdown, bead-side OR PromQL-side (ka-0000005167). Check both IsE2EAccountBead (bead layer) and costsRollupE2EAccountExclusion (PromQL layer) are actually excluding.
   - **MISSING-SERIES** — expr references a metric/label absent from vmsingle. Distinguish a naming bug (fix) from an honest no-data condition (the surface must say so, not imply $0).
   - **OK** — displayed == truth within tolerance and the query is honest.

### Re-verify the five seed findings (iteration-0 baseline, all FIXED)
Each must still hold; a regression on any is a P0. Table with file:line citations + fix MRs in gardenio/docs/costs-crisp-audit-harness.md (§Seed):
- I / headline: subscription window bill present (billing_type branch), NOT calendar-day — ka-0000003343 / !6182.
- R / trust floor: per-pair floors match values.yaml (settled-vs-bill 0.5, bill-conservation 0.85), lockstep test green — ka-0000007295 / !6177.
- S / e2e: no e2e account in by-account or any dropdown, bead + PromQL layer — ka-0000005167 / !6186.
- C / By-model: grouped by gardenio_tag_cost_usd{dim="model"}, not the optional bead field — ka-0000006501 / !6188.
- C / settled cost: explorer reads gardenio_agent_spend_logs_usd, dead-counter panel gone — ka-0000002699 / !6192.

### REQUIRED self-test (prove the harness has teeth)
An audit that can only report OK is worthless. Feed the cross-check a fabricated 'displayed' headline equal to the calendar-UTC-day GrandTotalUSD while the account is subscription-billed, and ASSERT the cross-check classifies it WRONG-WINDOW, not OK. Record the assertion under a `_selftest` key in crosscheck.json. If it does not fire, the run is VOID — the harness is blind.

### Deliverables
- docs/costs-crisp/{{ITERATION}}/crosscheck.json — one row per surface/number, plus the `_selftest` key.
- Comment: counts by verdict class (OK / WRONG-WINDOW / AGGREGATION-DRIFT / UNIT / STALE / SYNTHETIC-POLLUTION / MISSING-SERIES), the worst offenders, and the five-seed re-verification result. Primary input to the Correct score in step 4.

steps.title: /costs CRISP ({{ITERATION}}): score Correct / Reconciled / Intelligible / Sanitized / Presentation
steps.description:
## Step 4: Judge — the CRISP rubric (0-10 per dimension)

Combine the objective crosscheck.json (step 3) with a VISUAL review of the captured PNGs. You MUST actually look at the desktop AND narrow screenshots before scoring — Presentation and Intelligible cannot be scored from JSON alone. Bar for 'good' is 8; /costs is the operator's primary money surface.

- **C — Correct (accuracy)** — the HEAVIEST dimension, drawn straight from crosscheck.json. 9-10: every number == its source, every query honest. 7-8: all sources present, at most cosmetic drift. 4-6: ≥1 AGGREGATION-DRIFT / UNIT / STALE that misleads an operator. 1-3: a headline or explorer number simply wrong (a WRONG-WINDOW headline or a dead-counter read).
- **R — Reconciled (drift honesty)** — is every trust-strip pair judged against the same floor the C5 vmalert uses, and is every divergence closed or documented structural with a measured band? 9-10: floors match values.yaml (lockstep test green), every red badge means a real problem, every structural-low pair labelled as such. 4-6: a badge red on a stale floor, or a structural gap painted red with no band. 1-3: the strip lies about severity.
- **I — Intelligible (does the number mean what an operator thinks)** — does the headline bill against the SUBSCRIPTION window (not the calendar day), and does the label say which? 9-10: subscription headline with the binding 5h/7d window named + countdown, calendar-day demoted. 4-6: right number, ambiguous label. 1-3: a calendar-day sum masquerading as the subscription bill (the epic's founding defect).
- **S — Sanitized (no synthetic pollution)** — are e2e/fixture/test accounts absent from every list, ranking, and dropdown, BOTH bead-side and PromQL-side? 9-10: zero synthetic rows anywhere, both layers filtering. 4-6: filtered one layer but a gauge series leaks into a dropdown. 1-3: e2e accounts in the by-account view.
- **P — Presentation** — Tufte signal-per-pixel + dark-theme craft, both viewports, honest empty states. 9-10: flagship, readable at both viewports, no silent No-data. 4-6: generic/sparse or a $0 that reads as data. 1-3: broken rendering / overflow.

Overall = mean of the five. Write docs/costs-crisp/{{ITERATION}}/verdicts.json with {score, verdict, observations, issues[], recommendations[]} per dimension (mirror the GRADE verdicts.json shape).

steps.title: /costs CRISP ({{ITERATION}}): file bug beads per low dimension / accuracy drift (+ short honest-cut idea list)
steps.description:
## Step 5: File Issues (+ a short idea list)

### File issues
For every dimension scoring <= 7 in verdicts.json, file ONE bug bead with that dimension's concrete recommendations, parented to {{PARENT_EPIC}}, labelled area:observability + kind:crisp + the dimension. ALSO file one bead per distinct WRONG-WINDOW / AGGREGATION-DRIFT / UNIT / STALE / SYNTHETIC-POLLUTION / MISSING-SERIES(naming-bug) row in crosscheck.json — these are the 'cross-check displayed vs actual and fix' deliverables the operator asked for; they edit costs.go / costs_rollup.go / costs_trust.go / templates/costs.html or the account-bead producer. De-dupe against still-open kind:crisp beads from prior iterations — comment a new data point on the existing bead rather than refiling. A regression on any of the five seed findings is a P0.

### Ideate (lighter than GRADE — /costs is a fixed page)
Unlike Grafana's open-ended graph-idea catalogue, /costs is a hand-written page, so the idea half is a SHORT list of missing HONEST cost cuts the operator can't currently read: e.g. per-account 5h-vs-7d window headroom, subscription-vs-metered fleet split, cost-per-closed-bead efficiency, throttle-event timeline correlated with utilisation, estimate-vs-settled trend per project. Record each as {title, surface, source, the operator question it answers} in docs/costs-crisp/{{ITERATION}}/idea-catalog.md and carry the best forward as a Presentation/Depth bead only if it scores the page below bar. Do NOT invent metered-API estimation — the read-only cost contract holds (LiteLLM stays authoritative, epic ka-0000000758).

### Deliverables
- idea-catalog.md (short, grounded in a real source).
- Bug beads (one per low dimension + one per accuracy drift), de-duped, parented to {{PARENT_EPIC}}.
- Comment: bead IDs filed/updated this iteration, grouped by dimension.

steps.title: /costs CRISP ({{ITERATION}}): publish roll-up report and land the MR
steps.description:
## Step 6: Report + Land MR

Roll the iteration up on the parent epic and land captures + crosscheck + verdicts + idea-catalog on main via an MR so future iterations diff.

### Build docs/costs-crisp/{{ITERATION}}/REPORT.md
- Header table: iteration, VIEWER_URL, VM_URL, BEADS_URL, surfaces audited, gardener, parent epic, date.
- Headline: one-sentence verdict + overall mean, with delta vs the previous iteration.
- CRISP scorecard table: dimension | score | verdict | bug bead filed.
- Accuracy section: the crosscheck verdict-class counts + the worst drift rows called out explicitly (this is the operator's priority), and the five-seed re-verification result (each 'confirmed FIXED' or a P0 regression).
- Self-test line: confirm the WRONG-WINDOW self-test fired (else the run is void).
- Idea section: the short honest-cut list.
- Per-dimension prose: what holds it back + the rec.

### Land
- git add docs/costs-crisp/{{ITERATION}}/ ; commit `feat(gardenio/observability): /costs CRISP iteration {{ITERATION}}` ; push branch ; open MR (include the PROOF block — gardenio/docs/mr-proof-packet.md — and the Operator: trailer). Run `gb mr link` back to this step bead.
- Post the roll-up as a comment on {{PARENT_EPIC}} with the scorecard one-liner + bug bead IDs + MR link.
- If overall mean >= 8 with C (Correct) >= 9 and every seed finding still FIXED, file a decision bead asking the operator whether to slow the cadence or declare /costs believe-able.

### Deliverables
- REPORT.md merged via MR (linked to this bead with gb mr link).
- Roll-up comment on {{PARENT_EPIC}}.
- All step beads closed.
